1.title: What Would Charlie Kirk Do Today?
1.summary: A year after the killing of the 31-year-old conservative youth leader, the movement he helped create has splintered. Would that be the case if he were still alive?

2.title: San Francisco Mayor to Declare Rent Emergency Amid A.I. Housing Frenzy
2.summary: Mayor Daniel Lurie wants to combat evictions in the city, which has the nation’s highest rent increases.

3.title: Supreme Court Again Blocks Republican-Backed Missouri Voting Map
3.summary: The ruling deferred to Missouri’s state Supreme Court, which had invalidated G.O.P.-friendly district lines, saying voters must first have an opportunity to approve the map in a statewide referendum.

4.title: Yemen’s Houthis Seize Strategic Red Sea Port, Officials Say
4.summary: The Iran-backed militia routed Yemeni government forces in Mokha, putting the group in a stronger position to attack ships in a crucial waterway for global trade.

5.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
5.summary: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

6.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
6.summary: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.
